info.title: YunoFlow
info.description: Static reference snapshot of the YunoFlow REST + WebSocket API. YunoFlow was built for the Yuno AI Engineer hiring challenge; the live backend has been retired, so this documents the JSON request/response contract only — the endpoints below are not callable. The full source is at https://github.com/rajagurunath/yunoflow.

get.description: Readiness: confirm the database is reachable.

schema.title: Response List Agents Api Agents Get
Response Get Tools Api Tools Get
Response List Workflows Api Workflows Get

post.description:
Natural-language (or voice-transcribed) request -> agents + a workflow.

An LLM designs the spec; we create the agents (forced onto the configured
model so the result actually runs) and assemble the graph.

Spoken request -> text (ElevenLabs Scribe). The client then POSTs the text
to /generate, so the user can review the transcript before building.
Text -> spoken mp3 (ElevenLabs TTS) for the "voice-back" feature.
Plain-English summary of what a workflow does (the reverse of /generate).
